name: opencoder
description: Self-hosted collaborative coding pads for friends — a CoderPad-style multi-language IDE with realtime collab, terminal, interview rooms, code playback, and AI review.

scripts.db:setup: pnpm --filter @opencoder/api exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter @opencoder/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter @opencoder/shared build && pnpm -r --filter @opencoder/api build && pnpm -r --filter @opencoder/web build
